value.rationale: The five-cycle is the smallest prime in the motivating all-prime character-weighted cubic-chirp construction; exact amplitude tuning determines a natural and operationally meaningful normalized full-data lifted-conditioning margin. The sharp margin 0.278021... exceeds the motivating fixed-parameter value 0.072742... by factor >3.8 and completely identifies six bottleneck time-frequency shifts. It is not an arbitrary slice or simple indicator substitution; it determines a nontrivial balance point of two distinct ambiguity mechanisms across the entire nonnegative parameter half-line.
